name: Blind Cazul
summary: Blind Cazul is a transitional step in the Horde warlock trial to bind a succubus. After being directed by the coven leaders in the Cleft of Shadow, an initiate seeks out the sightless warlock Cazul, who points toward an object of intense emotion needed for the ritual.

sections.title: A Matter of Enticement
sections.body: Subjugating a demonic minion requires more than raw willpower; certain creatures of the Twisting Nether must be drawn across the veil by their innate cravings. A succubus, known as a devourer of souls, responds eagerly to mortal longing, sorrow, and unfulfilled desire. Cazul understands this well, recognizing immediately why an aspiring summoner has sought him out.

sections.title: Eyes in the Bluffs
sections.body: Despite his physical blindness, Cazul remains sharply attuned to the quiet lives and tragedies unfolding within Orgrimmar's red ramparts. Rather than sending the warlock directly to battle, he directs them to an orc woman named Zankaja living atop the bluffs near the wind rider roost. Zankaja has been anxiously waiting for the return of her mate, Dogran, harboring the very despair that demons find irresistible.

faq.answer: Cazul is a sightless warlock who operates quietly in Orgrimmar. He assists the warlocks of the Cleft of Shadow by identifying reagents and conduits for demonic summonings.

faq.q: Why does Cazul send you to Zankaja?
faq.answer: To summon and bind a succubus, an initiate requires an item steeped in powerful mortal yearning or love. Zankaja is waiting in distress for her missing mate, Dogran, making her personal connection the key to obtaining an emotional lure.

faq.q: Where can Zankaja be found in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Zankaja resides on the elevated bluffs of Orgrimmar, west of the wind rider roost. She can be reached by crossing the bridge from the flight tower and checking the nearby dwellings to the right.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Zankaja?
faq.answer: Zankaja is distressed because her mate Dogran has vanished. Speaking to her leads the warlock to search the Barrens for word of his fate, beginning the chain to retrieve a potent token of love.

faq.q: What kind of demon is this quest preparing you to summon?
faq.answer: This errand is part of the initiation rite to summon and enslave a succubus, a demonic minion that wields seduction and psychic torment.

faq.q: Why must warlocks exploit personal tragedies for their rituals?
faq.answer: Lesser demons like the succubus are drawn to intense mortal emotions—particularly passion, devotion, and heartbreak. Warlocks deliberately harness tokens tainted by grief or desire to serve as spiritual bait during the summoning ritual.

angles.text: This task demonstrates that demonic conjuration relies on psychological resonance as much as fel magic, requiring conduits of intense mortal emotion to lure a succubus.
The dark arts practiced deep in the Cleft of Shadow operate just beneath the surface of the Horde capital, quietly touching the lives of ordinary citizens living on the mesas above.
